name: wittens
description: Paste a TikTok link, get the file, move on.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter web build && WEB_DIST_PATH=web/dist API_PORT=3000 API_LISTEN_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0 tsx server/src/wittens.ts
